SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.UNIV_ID, U.UNIV_NAME, M.LOGIN_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.PHONE_NUMBER, M.STATUS, M.CREATED_AT, ( SELECT MAX(LL.LOG_TIME) FROM LOGIN_LOG LL WHERE LL.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND LL.RESULT = 'SUCCESS' ) AS LOGTIME_AT FROM MEMBER M JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID
ORDER BY
M.MEMBER_NAME ASC, U.UNIV_NAME ASC, M.MEMBER_ID ASC
M.CREATED_AT DESC, M.MEMBER_ID DESC
U.UNIV_NAME ASC, M.MEMBER_NAME ASC, M.MEMBER_ID ASC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER M JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ACTIVE_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.STATUS = 'SUSPENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SUSPENDED_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS WITHDRAWN_COUNT FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.ROLE = 'ADM' AND M.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID, M.UNIV_ID, U.UNIV_NAME, M.LOGIN_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.PHONE_NUMBER, M.STATUS, M.CREATED_AT, ( SELECT MAX(LL.LOG_TIME) FROM LOGIN_LOG LL WHERE LL.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND LL.RESULT = 'SUCCESS' ) AS LOGTIME_AT FROM MEMBER M JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND M.ROLE = 'ADM' AND M.UNIV_ID IS NOT NULL

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTICE N WHERE N.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) AS noticeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST P WHERE P.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) AS postCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POST_COMMENT C WHERE C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) AS commentCount, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT IP.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID) FROM INQUIRY_PARTICIPANT IP WHERE IP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ) AS inquiryCount FROM DUAL

SELECT LL.LOG_ID AS logId, LL.RESULT AS result, LL.FAIL_REASON AS failReason, LL.LOG_TIME AS logTime FROM LOGIN_LOG LL WHERE LL.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY LL.LOG_TIME DESC, LL.LOG_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT LL.LOG_ID AS logId, LL.RESULT AS result, LL.FAIL_REASON AS failReason, LL.LOG_TIME AS logTime FROM LOGIN_LOG LL WHERE LL.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY LL.LOG_TIME DESC, LL.LOG_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'NOTICE-' || N.NOTICE_ID AS id, 'NOTICE' AS type, N.TITLE AS title, N.TARGET AS description, CASE WHEN N.IS_DELETED = 1 THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'VISIBLE' END AS status, N.POSTED_AT AS occurredAt FROM NOTICE N WHERE N.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY N.POSTED_AT DESC, N.NOTICE_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'POST-' || P.POST_ID AS id, 'POST' AS type, P.TITLE AS title, B.BOARD_NAME AS description, CASE WHEN P.IS_DELETED = 1 THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'VISIBLE' END AS status, P.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM POST P LEFT JOIN BOARD_TYPE B ON B.BOARD_ID = P.BOARD_ID WHERE P.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.POST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'COMMENT-' || C.COMMENT_ID AS id, 'COMMENT' AS type, '댓글' AS title, '댓글' AS description, CASE WHEN C.IS_DELETED = 1 THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'VISIBLE' END AS status, C.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM POST_COMMENT C WHERE C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC, C.COMMENT_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'INQUIRY-' || R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID AS id, 'INQUIRY' AS type, R.TITLE AS title, R.CATEGORY AS description, CASE WHEN R.STATUS = 'PROGRESS' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE R.STATUS END AS status, R.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM INQUIRY_PARTICIPANT IP JOIN INQUIRY_ROOMS R ON R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID = IP.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID WHERE IP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql: M.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, M.UNIV_ID AS univId, U.UNIV_NAME AS univName, MD.DEPT_ID AS deptId, D.DEPT_NAME AS deptName, M.LOGIN_ID AS loginId, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, M.ROLE AS role, M.PHONE_NUMBER AS phoneNumber, M.GENDER AS gender, M.STATUS AS status, M.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, ( SELECT MAX(LL.LOG_TIME) FROM LOGIN_LOG LL WHERE LL.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND LL.RESULT = 'SUCCESS' ) AS logtimeAt, MD.COMMUNITY_NICKNAME AS communityNickname, M.BIRTH AS birth
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON MD.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = MD.DEPT_ID
ORDER BY
M.CREATED_AT ASC, M.MEMBER_ID ASC
M.MEMBER_NAME ASC, M.MEMBER_ID ASC
U.UNIV_NAME ASC NULLS LAST, M.MEMBER_NAME ASC, M.MEMBER_ID ASC
M.ROLE ASC, M.MEMBER_NAME ASC, M.MEMBER_ID ASC
( SELECT MAX(LL.LOG_TIME) FROM LOGIN_LOG LL WHERE LL.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID AND LL.RESULT = 'SUCCESS' ) DESC NULLS LAST, M.MEMBER_ID DESC
M.CREATED_AT DESC, M.MEMBER_ID DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON MD.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = MD.DEPT_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activeCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.STATUS = 'SUSPENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS suspendedCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS withdrawnCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.ROLE = 'STU' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS studentCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.ROLE = 'PROF' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS professorCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.ROLE = 'ALU' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS alumniCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN M.ROLE = 'GUEST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS guestCount FROM MEMBER M WHERE M.ROLE IN ('GUEST', 'STU', 'PROF', 'ALU')

SELECT
FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = M.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL MD ON MD.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = MD.DEPT_ID WHERE M.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND M.ROLE IN ('GUEST', 'STU', 'PROF', 'ALU')

SELECT LL.LOG_ID AS logId, LL.RESULT AS result, LL.FAIL_REASON AS failReason, LL.LOG_TIME AS logTime FROM LOGIN_LOG LL WHERE LL.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY LL.LOG_TIME DESC, LL.LOG_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT LL.LOG_ID AS logId, LL.RESULT AS result, LL.FAIL_REASON AS failReason, LL.LOG_TIME AS logTime FROM LOGIN_LOG LL WHERE LL.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY LL.LOG_TIME DESC, LL.LOG_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'POST-' || P.POST_ID AS id, 'POST' AS type, P.TITLE AS title, B.BOARD_NAME AS description, CASE WHEN P.IS_DELETED = 1 THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'VISIBLE' END AS status, P.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM POST P LEFT JOIN BOARD_TYPE B ON B.BOARD_ID = P.BOARD_ID WHERE P.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} UNION ALL SELECT 'COMMENT-' || C.COMMENT_ID AS id, 'COMMENT' AS type, '댓글' AS title, '댓글' AS description, CASE WHEN C.IS_DELETED = 1 THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'VISIBLE' END AS status, C.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM POST_COMMENT C WHERE C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ) ORDER BY occurredAt DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'POST-' || P.POST_ID AS id, 'POST' AS type, P.TITLE AS title, B.BOARD_NAME AS description, CASE WHEN P.IS_DELETED = 1 THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'VISIBLE' END AS status, P.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM POST P LEFT JOIN BOARD_TYPE B ON B.BOARD_ID = P.BOARD_ID WHERE P.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.POST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'COMMENT-' || C.COMMENT_ID AS id, 'COMMENT' AS type, '댓글' AS title, '댓글' AS description, CASE WHEN C.IS_DELETED = 1 THEN 'DELETED' ELSE 'VISIBLE' END AS status, C.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM POST_COMMENT C WHERE C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC, C.COMMENT_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'STU-COURSE-' || E.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AS id, 'STUDENT_COURSE' AS type, LC.LEC_COD_NAME AS title, TO_CHAR(S.SEM_YEAR) || ' ' || S.SEM_TERM AS description, E.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS AS status, L.LEC_REG_DATE AS occurredAt FROM LMS_PROFILE LP JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT E ON E.LMS_PRF_ID = LP.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN LECTURE L ON L.LEC_ID = E.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE LC ON LC.LEC_CODE_ID = L.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS S ON S.SEM_ID = L.SEM_ID WHERE LP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} UNION ALL SELECT 'PROF-COURSE-' || L.LEC_ID AS id, 'PROFESSOR_COURSE' AS type, LC.LEC_COD_NAME AS title, TO_CHAR(S.SEM_YEAR) || ' ' || S.SEM_TERM AS description, L.LEC_VAL_STATUS AS status, L.LEC_REG_DATE AS occurredAt FROM LMS_PROFILE LP JOIN LECTURE L ON L.LMS_PRF_ID = LP.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE LC ON LC.LEC_CODE_ID = L.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS S ON S.SEM_ID = L.SEM_ID WHERE LP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ) ORDER BY occurredAt DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'STU-COURSE-' || E.LEC_STD_ENR_ID AS id, 'STUDENT_COURSE' AS type, LC.LEC_COD_NAME AS title, TO_CHAR(S.SEM_YEAR) || ' ' || S.SEM_TERM AS description, E.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS AS status, L.LEC_REG_DATE AS occurredAt FROM LMS_PROFILE LP JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT E ON E.LMS_PRF_ID = LP.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN LECTURE L ON L.LEC_ID = E.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE LC ON LC.LEC_CODE_ID = L.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS S ON S.SEM_ID = L.SEM_ID WHERE LP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} UNION ALL SELECT 'PROF-COURSE-' || L.LEC_ID AS id, 'PROFESSOR_COURSE' AS type, LC.LEC_COD_NAME AS title, TO_CHAR(S.SEM_YEAR) || ' ' || S.SEM_TERM AS description, L.LEC_VAL_STATUS AS status, L.LEC_REG_DATE AS occurredAt FROM LMS_PROFILE LP JOIN LECTURE L ON L.LMS_PRF_ID = LP.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE LC ON LC.LEC_CODE_ID = L.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS S ON S.SEM_ID = L.SEM_ID WHERE LP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ) ORDER BY occurredAt DESC, id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT E.LEC_STD_ENR_ID FROM LMS_PROFILE LP JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT E ON E.LMS_PRF_ID = LP.LMS_PRF_ID WHERE LP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} UNION ALL SELECT L.LEC_ID FROM LMS_PROFILE LP JOIN LECTURE L ON L.LMS_PRF_ID = LP.LMS_PRF_ID WHERE LP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} )

SELECT 'SUBMISSION-' || S.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID AS id, 'SUBMISSION' AS type, A.LEC_ASN_TITLE AS title, LC.LEC_COD_NAME AS description, S.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS AS status, S.LEC_ASN_SBM_REG_DATE AS occurredAt FROM LMS_PROFILE LP JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION S ON S.LMS_PRF_ID = LP.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT A ON A.LEC_ASN_ID = S.LEC_ASN_ID JOIN LECTURE L ON L.LEC_ID = A.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE LC ON LC.LEC_CODE_ID = L.LEC_CODE_ID WHERE LP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY S.LEC_ASN_SBM_REG_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'SUBMISSION-' || S.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID AS id, 'SUBMISSION' AS type, A.LEC_ASN_TITLE AS title, LC.LEC_COD_NAME AS description, S.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS AS status, S.LEC_ASN_SBM_REG_DATE AS occurredAt FROM LMS_PROFILE LP JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION S ON S.LMS_PRF_ID = LP.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT A ON A.LEC_ASN_ID = S.LEC_ASN_ID JOIN LECTURE L ON L.LEC_ID = A.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE LC ON LC.LEC_CODE_ID = L.LEC_CODE_ID WHERE LP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY S.LEC_ASN_SBM_REG_DATE DESC, S.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LMS_PROFILE LP JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION S ON S.LMS_PRF_ID = LP.LMS_PRF_ID WHERE LP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'SEAT-' || R.RESERVATION_ID AS id, 'READING_SEAT' AS type, RR.ROOM_NAME || ' ' || S.SEAT_NUMBER AS title, TO_CHAR(R.START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(R.END_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS description, R.STATUS AS status, R.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS R JOIN READING_ROOM_SEATS S ON S.SEAT_ID = R.SEAT_ID JOIN READING_ROOMS RR ON RR.READING_ROOM_ID = S.READING_ROOM_ID WHERE R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} UNION ALL SELECT 'ROOM-' || R.RESERVATION_ID AS id, 'MEETING_ROOM' AS type, MR.ROOM_NAME AS title, TO_CHAR(R.START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(R.END_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS description, R.STATUS AS status, R.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS R JOIN MEETING_ROOMS MR ON MR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID WHERE R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} UNION ALL SELECT 'PENALTY-' || P.PENALTY_ID AS id, 'PENALTY' AS type, P.PENALTY_TYPE AS title, P.REASON AS description, P.STATUS AS status, P.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM RESERVATION_PENALTIES P WHERE P.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ) ORDER BY occurredAt DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT 'SEAT-' || R.RESERVATION_ID AS id, 'READING_SEAT' AS type, RR.ROOM_NAME || ' ' || S.SEAT_NUMBER AS title, TO_CHAR(R.START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(R.END_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS description, R.STATUS AS status, R.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS R JOIN READING_ROOM_SEATS S ON S.SEAT_ID = R.SEAT_ID JOIN READING_ROOMS RR ON RR.READING_ROOM_ID = S.READING_ROOM_ID WHERE R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} UNION ALL SELECT 'ROOM-' || R.RESERVATION_ID AS id, 'MEETING_ROOM' AS type, MR.ROOM_NAME AS title, TO_CHAR(R.START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' ~ ' || TO_CHAR(R.END_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS description, R.STATUS AS status, R.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS R JOIN MEETING_ROOMS MR ON MR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID WHERE R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ) ORDER BY occurredAt DESC, id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'PENALTY-' || P.PENALTY_ID AS id, 'PENALTY' AS type, P.PENALTY_TYPE AS title, P.REASON AS description, P.STATUS AS status, P.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM RESERVATION_PENALTIES P WHERE P.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.PENALTY_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'INQUIRY-' || R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID AS id, 'INQUIRY' AS type, R.TITLE AS title, R.CATEGORY AS description, CASE WHEN R.STATUS = 'PROGRESS' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE R.STATUS END AS status, R.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM INQUIRY_PARTICIPANT IP JOIN INQUIRY_ROOMS R ON R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID = IP.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID WHERE IP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT 'INQUIRY-' || R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID AS id, 'INQUIRY' AS type, R.TITLE AS title, R.CATEGORY AS description, CASE WHEN R.STATUS = 'PROGRESS' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE R.STATUS END AS status, R.CREATED_AT AS occurredAt FROM INQUIRY_PARTICIPANT IP JOIN INQUIRY_ROOMS R ON R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID = IP.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID WHERE IP.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.INQUIRY_ROOM_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
